request: slコマンド、SLのアスキーアートが発信するだけのもの

spec.name: sl
spec.summary: sl prints a small original ASCII art steam locomotive to standard output.
behavior: B1: With no arguments, print exactly these 6 lines to stdout, each ended by a newline, then exit 0: line1 '     (  )', line2 '    (  )', line3 '  ___    _______', line4 ' |   |__|  _  _ |', line5 ' |__________________|', line6 '  (o)(o)(o)(o)(o)'.
B2: Standard input is never read; any stdin content is ignored.
B3: If any positional argument is given, print 'sl: unexpected argument: <first argument>' to stderr, print nothing to stdout, and exit 2.
B4: An unknown flag prints the flag package error and usage to stderr and exits 2.
B5: Nothing is written to stderr on success.
